items.title: The union of finitely many nowhere dense sets is nowhere dense
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the stability of nowhere density under finite unions (author lemma at source lines 4221-4225, label lemma-nowhere-dense). The proof (source lines 4227-4236) reduces to the case of two sets by induction and then argues with the closure identity: an open subset of the closure of the union would meet each closure in an open subset, contradicting the nowhere density of the two pieces (proof lines 4230-4235). The statement is used in the section's treatment of open dense subsets and Baire-type properties. H2.
